recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片血液稀釋明顯，有核細胞沿著顆粒周邊聚集，多為中型骨髓系前驅細胞與小淋巴球；此倍率看不出成熟停滯的細節。
features: Hemodilute aspirate with a dense red cell background
Small clusters of nucleated cells along particle trails
Mixed medium-sized precursors with purple granular cytoplasm and small dark lymphocytes/erythroid cells
Mature segmented neutrophils not readily identified at this power, but detail is limited
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute, with small aggregates of nucleated cells along particle trails in a dense red cell background. The nucleated cells include medium-sized granulated precursors and small dark lymphocytes or erythroid precursors; mature segmented neutrophils are not readily apparent, but the magnification precludes reliable assessment. High-power evaluation is needed to document maturation arrest of granulopoiesis as seen in severe congenital neutropenia.

ddx.vs: A peripheral blood-diluted sample may underrepresent marrow elements; particle cellularity and biopsy correlation are needed.
Reactive marrow shows full maturation to bands and segmented neutrophils on high power.
